close_reason: Created tests/contactcard_tests.rs (4 tests: get, changes, set create, copy fromAccountId); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-contacts-client/tests/contacts_card_tests.rs with 7 async wiremock tests. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-contacts-10 §4.1 (ContactCard/get example), RFC 8620 §5.3 (set), §5.4 (copy).

**Tests:**
1. contact_card_get_returns_spec_example: mock returns §4.1 fixture; assert card id=="3", address_book_ids has expected key.
2. contact_card_get_with_specific_ids_sends_ids_array: assert request ids==["card1","card2"].
3. contact_card_changes_sends_since_state_and_max_changes: assert sinceState and maxChanges in request.
4. contact_card_set_create_returns_server_assigned_id: assert created["newCard"].id=="server-99".
5. contact_card_copy_sends_from_account_id: assert request has fromAccountId=="src-account" and accountId=="a0x9".
6. contact_card_set_empty_destroy_id_returns_invalid_argument: call with destroy [""]; assert InvalidArgument before network.
7. contact_card_copy_empty_from_account_id_returns_invalid_argument: assert InvalidArgument before network.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 7 tests pass.
title: Wiremock tests: ContactCard/get /changes /set /copy
